queries_run: Carrier Global distribution channel shift 2026 distributors inventory
Carrier Global business model transition subscription platform 2026

findings.claim: 10-K：產品與服務仍以直銷建築承包商／業主，及間接透過合資、獨立業務代表、經銷商、批發商、經銷點與零售通路銷售；運輸部門含訂閱式貨物監控，未顯示通路結構性轉移。
findings.excerpt: Products and controls, services and systems are sold directly to building contractors and owners and indirectly through joint ventures, independent sales representatives, distributors, wholesalers, dealers and retail outlets.

findings.claim: 10-K：運輸部門的服務與售後擴張包含隨需與訂閱式貨物監控（小規模訂閱化）。
findings.excerpt: our focus on digitalization and innovation is expanding our offering of service and aftermarket solutions, including on-demand and subscription-based monitoring of customer cargo.

findings.claim: Carrier 稱土耳其 Alarko Carrier 合資持股出售後將改採新營運模式、自行承接 Carrier 與 Toshiba 產品的經銷（預計 2026 Q4 完成）。

channel_business_model_shift.note: 通路去庫存（2025 年底住宅現場庫存年減約30%）屬週期性調整而非結構轉移；Cooling-as-a-Service 與 Carrier Energy 為小規模新模式，未找到量化營收。

clues.claim: 管理層稱要將住宅現場庫存於 2025 年底降 30% 年減，按經銷商與 SKU 管理。
clues.source: Carrier Goldman Sachs Industrials Auto Week 2025-12-04 transcript

clues.claim: Carrier 推出 Cooling-as-a-Service 服務化商業模式，客戶以固定費用取代前期設備支出。
clues.source: Carrier 官網新聞：Carrier Launches New Service-Based Model
